newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZAI DAIRY MOST ACTIVE STOCK ON CM.
newsitem.headline: BIRZAI DAIRY MOST ACTIVE STOCK ON CM.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that the most active stock on the central market last week was Birzai Diary.
The bourse said in a statement that Birzai's turnover on the central market last week was 524,475 litas followed by Lithuanian Energy at 355,675 litas and Hermis Bank in trade of 393,705 litas.
The bourse also said that Hermis Bank registered the highest turnover in block trades at 2.41 million litas.
Lithuania's Savings Bank saw 1.36 million litas worth of its shares change hands in block trades, closely followed by fridge producer Snaige in turnover of 1.2 million litas.
Snaige was also the biggest gainer of last week with its price rising by 29.4 percent to 11 litas.
Confectionary firm Pergale gained by 22.21 percent to 16.52 litas last week followed by Vilniaus Vodka with a 18.52 percent rise to 1.89 litas.
In the banking sector Siauliu Bank was the most bullish, rising to 94 litas from 85 litas.
